W44

Rubric editor

/teach/courses/:courseId/rubrics/:rubricId/edit
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P49

Define clear criteria and scoring levels with validated totals, learner preview and protected in-use version changes.

Entry and return
W43 new/edit rubricW50 returned proposal
Layout regions
Criteria listStable IDs, point maxima and reorder controls
Level matrixDescriptors and score values with text alternatives
Checks/previewTotals, duplicate levels, learner view and usage status
Fields and validation (5)
FieldTypeRequiredValidationDefaultVisible to
Rubric titletextYes1–120 characters, distinct enough for selection—Authorised staff
Criterion descriptionsrich text listYesAt least one; stable IDs; nonblank learner-facing descriptions—Authorised staff
Level descriptors/scoresmatrixYesNonblank descriptors, finite nonnegative values no greater than criterion maximum; unique ordered levels—Authorised staff
Maximum pointsdecimalYesSum criterion maxima; must match attached question before use—Authorised staff
Change reasontextareaNoRequired for an in-use revision proposal; explain wording versus score effect—Authorised staff

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Remove criterion
  • Usage count and affected score mappings
  • Removal from in-use rubric is a proposal; historical feedback retains original criterion
Return without applying changesRemove from draft
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Reordering criteria preserves their IDs and attached feedback references.
  • A score above criterion maximum blocks Ready and identifies its cell.
  • TA proposal cannot change scores, manual overrides or released snapshots.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
